modules.title: Module 1: Business Fundamentals Overview
modules.description: Introduction to business fundamentals, including definitions and key concepts.

sub_modules.title: Business Types and Functions
sub_modules.description: Explore different types of businesses (sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation) and their functions.

sub_modules.title: Business Structure and Governance
sub_modules.description: Learn about the different structures (sole proprietorship, partnership, corporation) and governance models.

modules.title: Module 2: Financial Management and Accounting
modules.description: Introduction to financial management, accounting principles and practices.

sub_modules.title: Financial Statements and Analysis
sub_modules.description: Learn about different types of financial statements (balance sheet, income statement) and their analysis.

sub_modules.title: Financial Planning and Budgeting
sub_modules.description: Learn how to prepare financial plans and budgets.

modules.title: Module 3: Marketing and Sales
modules.description: Introduction to marketing and sales strategies.

sub_modules.title: Marketing Mix and Segmentation
sub_modules.description: Learn about the 4 Ps of marketing (product, price, promotion, place) and segmentation techniques.

sub_modules.title: Sales Strategies and Techniques
sub_modules.description: Learn about different sales strategies (b2b, b2c) and techniques.

modules.title: Module 4: Human Resource Management and Operations
modules.description: Introduction to human resource management, operations management.

sub_modules.title: Human Resources and Recruitment
sub_modules.description: Learn about the different aspects of HRM (recruitment, selection, training) and recruitment strategies.

sub_modules.title: Operations Management and Supply Chain
sub_modules.description: Learn about operations management, supply chain strategies and logistics.
